memories.content: Capitalization rules preserve sentence case.

memories.title: Public MCP capabilities use distinct namespaced edge routes
memories.content: The public DEV edge exposes Skills MCP at POST /mcp/skills and Case-memory MCP at POST /mcp/case-memory. Generic routes return 404. Provider configuration must use the capability-specific route and preserve the separate authority boundaries.

memories.title: Development Docker builds isolate workspace dependencies
memories.content: The development image excludes host node_modules, installs locked dependencies, and keeps deployment builds reproducible. Regression coverage protects the Docker image and dependency policy.

memories.title: Case-memory MCP is the private bounded retrieval boundary
memories.content: When recent conversation coverage is incomplete, the Agent may retrieve prior claimant conversation through the separate read-only Case-memory MCP. Retrieved text cannot establish evidence authority.

memories.title: Workspace package scope is @aico
memories.content: Workspace packages and package filters use the @aico scope. Do not introduce the old @aco scope.

memories.title: Claim investigation prepares the case and the handler chooses treatment
memories.content: The platform investigates the claimant declaration and prepares evidence. It does not decide coverage or indemnity; the claims handler chooses appraisal, treatment, or exclusion.

memories.title: Bounded option replies use request-local selection
memories.content: Conversational option replies relate a claimant answer to one of several bounded choices. Runtime validates the selection authority.

memories.title: Web Chat sessions recover by visible case reference
memories.content: The claimant channel recovers an existing conversation session by tenant and case identifiers without creating new state.

memories.title: Auto inspection invitation is Runtime-owned
memories.content: Runtime owns the inspection URL, claimant invitation, delivery recovery, and execution authority after tool completion.

memories.title: Web Chat completion communication is Runtime-owned
memories.content: The channel renders accepted completion messages. Runtime owns current-version authority and deterministic claimant communication.

memories.title: Confirmed investigation interprets policy.retrieve NOT_FOUND
memories.content: After a failed policy lookup returns NOT_FOUND, Runtime asks for one corrected policy reference and preserves the retry limit regression guard.
